source: NZ data enrichment review, 22 Oct 2026 (Platform Admin 07:22, 13:28)

resolutions.gap: Search kept spending on providers with no course pages online
resolutions.resolution: Site checked once (site map) before any search; search off where the site lists 5 or fewer course pages; never-search list (NZIST, work-based learning, Skills Group, Skills Update, Te Rūnanga); bulk onboarding requests obey the same rules
measures: Providers waiting for their site map

resolutions.gap: Title search found the wrong page at universities and polytechnics
resolutions.resolution: Universities: own course list (site list, AI match, adapter) first; title search only for courses the list missed; stop after 20 wrong pages in a row
measures: University courses with a right page

resolutions.resolution: Pages that need a browser rendered within a day; address guesses off for NZ; pages refused by robots.txt listed for a person (one flag per provider)
measures: Pages read with a browser yesterday
Pages still needing a browser or blocked
Providers listed for pages refused by robots.txt

resolutions.gap: AI field reader skipped half of what it tried
resolutions.resolution: Quote not on the page: asked once more with a note; unchanged page not asked again; campus and international filled from provider-level or registered facts when the page is silent

resolutions.gap: Campus answers waiting for a person
resolutions.resolution: Platform Admin approves each university's campus list in Layer 4 (about 1 hour); then most waiting campus items settle by themselves
measures: Campus items waiting for a person

resolutions.gap: Fee reader read pages without fee tables; 2 reads failed
resolutions.resolution: Hidden characters removed; pages without a money amount not sent to the AI; fee-page links followed
measures: Fee pages read with fee rows yesterday
Fee pages read without rows yesterday

resolutions.gap: AI page match often had nothing to choose from
resolutions.resolution: AI asked only with at least 2 candidates; retried only while retries find right pages
measures: Courses with too few candidates yesterday (no AI call)

resolutions.gap: Flags raised per course, not per provider
resolutions.resolution: One flag on the provider when search is off for it; its per-course page-not-found flags cleared; each flag shows the toolset tried before it
measures: Course flags: no course page found

resolutions.gap: Toolset stats were not kept over time
resolutions.resolution: Toolset use recorded per provider and tool every day; Toolset use sheet in this report

lessons.lesson: A rule that lets 'a request' through must say whose request. Onboarding asks for searches the same way a person does, so the new search gates let 726 bulk onboardings straight through (374 wrong pages for 4 right in the first hours).
lessons.action: Gates now pass only a person's request (bulk onboarding waits); new gates are checked against every caller that can ask.

lessons.lesson: A check written inside a sub-query must name its table: 'provider_id' meant the pause list's own column, so the pause stopped all onboarding and automatic plans for about 40 minutes.
lessons.action: Qualified the column; dry runs now also run the changed job once and check it moved something.

lessons.lesson: Measure the result, not the action: the AI page-match retry counted any chosen page as success (21%), while chosen pages that were right was 1.4%.
lessons.action: Retry cap counts right pages; every resolution has a daily measure on this sheet.

lessons.lesson: Title search alone rarely finds the course page of a small provider: 1 right page per 10 searches overall, about 1 in 90 at small providers.
lessons.action: Check the provider's own site first; search only where the site lists course pages.

lessons.lesson: Half of the AI field reader's skips are pages that do not state the field; asking again gives the same answer.
lessons.action: Unchanged pages are not asked again; provider-level facts fill campus and international where sound.
